judge-football.justification: Usable (7.0): clear tiebreaker rule (shrink a Hoop G run to about 0.4 reliability), blind 2025 draft card with named players, falsifiable 2026 kill rule. Lead is thin (partial rho 0.32, n=63, out-of-class dR2 interval includes zero, Holm p=0.063); card fold R2 is -1.18, order only; not a full ranked board. Difficulty (7.8): covers reliability both sides, MDE and TOST, snap opportunity and games played, no injury data, year-standardization, pooled-mean prior for pressure, EDGE vs interior, weight confounding. Gaps: scheme, stunts, blocker quality; pressure from charting; 42 of 69 cohort 3-cones imputed; selection from six metrics acknowledged not fixed. Unique (7.2): drill-as-measurement-problem reframe, Hoop G centripetal turning metric, blind-class draft card; burst-to-NFL idea ends in a null attributed to drill noise. Terminology (6.8): football language mostly correct; Hoop G in g unfamiliar to scouts; some players named without snap context; 'not priced in by draft' rests on rho=0.01.
top_changes: Add a full 2027 draft-room board: rank every current-class DL with a hoop run by shrunk Hoop G, with intervals, weight, EDGE/interior labels and film-vs-drill disagreement flags; show shrinkage arithmetic for 2-3 named prospects.

Deal with selection and the soft baseline: pre-register the 2026 test as one hypothesis; show result with imputed 3-cone/10-yd split players dropped; report a shrunk effect corrected for best-of-six selection.

Cut number of tests and add football mechanism: drop/shorten exploratory EDGE-only burst lead, Finding 1 correlation list and opportunity paragraph; explain Hoop G in football terms (turning the corner at speed) with stance, alignment, scheme caveats.

judge-datascience.justification: Re-ran analysis.py (~100 s); numbers.json regenerated with no differences across 407 keys. Independent checks on player_season_stats matched (DL 33,417 rush snaps, 2,704 pressures, 8.1% pooled, 69 players with 100+ rushes, median 297). Text matches numbers.json: Hoop G partial rho 0.32 (n=63), out-of-class dR2 +0.073 perm p 0.022, Holm 0.063, TOST 0.060, MDE true effects 0.78 and 0.84. Strengths: no-tracking baseline (weight, 10-yd, 3-cone, NGS athleticism, log pick, EDGE share), leave-one-class-out with in-fold imputer, blind 2025 card, year-standardized drills, ICC/Spearman-Brown reliability, power/TOST nulls, opportunity/injury checks, pooled-prior shrinkage, honest selection limitation. Innovation genuine: Hoop G from Savitzky-Golay smoothed positions with onset detection; drill first-second distance vs game get-off r=-0.80. Weaknesses: post-hoc headline lead, n=63 (~20/fold), dR2 CI [-0.086, 0.214] includes zero, Holm 0.063; 'Bend reappears' and 'improves rank forecasts' overstate (2024 rank 0.63 to 0.61, 2025 R2 -0.88); 42 of 69 3-cone imputed; OLS 6 covariates at n~63; 2026 stopping rule is Fisher z arithmetic not pre-registered; wide bootstrap CIs; Hoop G reliability 0.41 rests on 10 repeaters via split-half Spearman-Brown (0.26 split-half), not stated; EDGE 0.42 vs interior 0.03 untested contrast.
top_changes: Selection-honest test: rerun full metric screen inside nested LOCO, permutation p for best-of-k, report out-of-class dR2 under it; soften 'Bend reappears' to 'a lead'.
Check baseline overfit/imputation leakage: ridge or smaller baseline, with and without imputed 3-cone, class random-effect model, bootstrap resampling whole classes/players.
Tighten Hoop G reliability (bootstrap CI, MDE over 0.26-0.41) and EDGE-vs-interior claim (interaction test or label descriptive); replicate burst lead on top-EPA half.

judge-writeup.justification: check.py passes (1,946 words, 5 figures plus 1 table). Structure follows finalist pattern; title two-sided; lede quantified and honest. Weaknesses: density and plain language. Opening paragraph packs partial rho, two CIs and unexplained 'true link of 0.78'; jargon (partial rho, dR2, Holm, TOST, Fisher z) in main text; 1,946 words near cap; Finding 2 run-on of numbers; Hoop G definition begins with physics; 'Why round 1's burst null was uninformative' references internal history; 'reappears' oversells given Holm 0.063 and dR2 CI including zero.
top_changes: Rewrite opening into ~70 plain words (Combine bend predicts NFL pressure rate beyond size, 10-yd split, 3-cone, draft slot, n=63; drill burst cannot be judged); move rho/CIs/0.78 to table; soften 'Bend reappears' to 'Bend is a lead'.
Move sensitivity cuts, per-class ranks, Holm, equivalence, Fisher z to appendix table; replace jargon with plain phrases; recast the round-1 heading as 'Why drill burst is hard to measure'.
Give Hoop G a one-sentence coach definition; move 'What a team can use' after Finding 2; shorten methods paragraphs to free ~200 words.
